name: io.github.Rewoltor/virag
title: Virág — Manhattan flower delivery
description: Order flowers with a handwritten card for delivery in Manhattan, NYC. Browse, quote, order, track.

tools.name: list_bouquets
tools.description: List the 5 flower bouquets Virág delivers in Manhattan, NYC (Petite $89, Sweet $119, Classic $159, Romantic $229, Grand Gesture $749). Each is a best seller from a New York florist. Prices include flowers, a card with the user's message, delivery and tax. Also returns delivery rules and how many pilot orders remain.

tools.name: check_delivery
tools.description: Check if a bouquet can be delivered to a ZIP code on a date. Pass the tier: petite and sweet go same-day only below 125th St. Use before create_order.

delivery_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (New York time). Omit for earliest.

tools.name: suggest_card_message
tools.description: Get ready-made messages for the card. Occasions: just_because, bad_week, apology, anniversary, birthday, romantic, new_relationship, congratulations, get_well, long_distance, mother, thank_you, new_baby, sympathy, holiday. Personalize one with details the user shared before ordering.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an order and get a secure Stripe checkout_url. The order is confirmed only after payment at checkout_url (pay it yourself if you are able to complete a card checkout for your user, otherwise give the link to your user). Always confirm tier, total price, recipient, address, date and card text with the user first. Reuse idempotency_key on retries.

tier.description: Which bouquet: petite ($89), sweet ($119), classic ($159), romantic ($229) or grand ($749). All prices include card, delivery and tax.

recipient_name.description: Full name of the person receiving the flowers.

recipient_phone.description: Recipient's US phone number. The courier calls it for building access.

address_line1.description: Street address in Manhattan, e.g. '245 E 19th St'.

delivery_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in New York time. Omit for the earliest available date.

card_message.description: Text for the card (handwritten for classic, romantic and grand; printed for petite and sweet), max 300 characters.

sender_name.description: How the card is signed, e.g. 'Love, Daniel'.

buyer_email.description: Buyer's email for the receipt and delivery confirmation.

delivery_instructions.description: Doorman, buzzer code, 'leave with front desk', etc.

agent_name.description: Optional: name of the AI agent/app placing the order (helps us support you).

idempotency_key.description: Optional: reuse the same key when retrying so the order is never created twice.

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status of an order: awaiting_payment, paid, placed (sent to florist), delivered, expired, refunded.

order_id.description: The order_id returned by create_order (starts with vg_)
